posts.text:
four weeks in, iran continues to export oil through the strait of hormuz. 

1.5 million barrels a day, at significantly higher prices than before the war.

new trump deadline just dropped.

strait still near completely closed for next two weeks? yes.
trump with second delay on self-imposed deadline…now paused until us troops are expected to arrive in persian gulf.

“no way!”
“way.”


*Walter Bloomberg (@DeItaone)

RUBIO: HORMUZ COULD BE OPENED TOMORROW IF IRAN ALLOWED IT



— https://nitter.net/DeItaone/status/2037225459570606439#m

3.2 million internally displaced inside iran.
1 million in lebanon.
158,000 arrivals from lebanon into syria. 43,000 into turkey.

this is the humanitarian cost of war.

houthi leader tells reuters they stand ready to disrupt the bab-al-mandab strait—if iran calls on them.. 

reuters.com/world/middle-eas…

the oecd on the iran war's economic cost: us inflation jumping to 4.2%. global growth slowing to 2.9%. eurozone growth at 0.8%.
and that's before accounting for fertilizer shortages. the food price shock is still coming.
15,800 years of dogs putting up with humans. moose doing his part.
nicolas sarkozy, france’s once tough on crime president, having a truly extraordinary time in prison…

take relief that trump avoided disaster this week.
but his climbdown wasn’t an off-ramp to ending the war. gzeromedia.com/by-ian-bremme…

ground troops in the gulf
a red line for trump supporters.
everything else? up for debate.
@gzeromedia

Video

if you’re iran right now, you hear lots of president trump talking about negotiations. while you see him 1) trying his hardest to talk down oil prices, 2) getting ground troops in place for phase two of operations.

the stated goal of the iran war: prevent nuclear weapons, protect israel, regime change.
what americans care about more: gas prices.

6:49am: sudden spike in oil futures trading. no news. no announcement. nothing public.
7:05am: trump announces a pause on iran strikes. markets move.
someone knew. 16 minutes early. $580 million in contracts. the corruption is staggering.

talked to @vicenews about how success in venezuela and trump’s previous attacks on iran led to this war.

Video

bipartisan legislation introduced to ban members of congress, the president, and senior executive branch officials from trading prediction markets.

the right move and long overdue. we already banned it at eurasia group.
